description: Source code for the LanguageScreen widget in a Flutter app, enabling users to select a language, persist their choice, and navigate to OTP validation.

classes.name: LanguageScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that allows the user to select a language from a list. It displays a title, subtitle, language options, and a next button. It saves the selected language preference and navigates to OTP validation screen on pressing 'NEXT'.

classes.name: _LanguageScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the language selection, UI, and navigation logic within LanguageScreen.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates and returns the mutable state for LanguageScreen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, including title, subtitle, language list, and the Next button.

methods.name: _onNext
methods.description: Handles the Next button press: saves the language preference and navigates to OTPValidationScreen.
